## Next Move
1. Finish `game.js` with playable kart controls, race/countdown/timer/lap logic, pickups, boosts, pause/restart, HUD, and render loop.
2. Check for syntax and browser runtime issues, then test gameplay.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report assumptions and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD structure.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and responsive layout.
- `game.js`: Current partial Three.js implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.

- Complete and verify a playable 3D 60-second kart time trial game, “Sunset Sprint,” in the existing project.

- Make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs at viewport width ≤1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Capture a JPEG at viewport width ≤1280px and inspect the latest screenshot.

- (none)

- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay implementation.
- `index.html`: Game interface and HUD.
- `style.css`: Presentation and responsive layout.
- `screenshots/`: Intended location for the requested screenshot, if created.
